stable.label: ecosystem-sandbox-creature-rig-local-tested
stable.note: The multi-creature ecosystem remains the primary GENESIS experience. Fluid refinement retains CI_PASS. A new morphology-aware creature/head rendering and jaw re-anchoring layer is source-wired and locally tested, but the deployed ecosystem route is still not live/device verified.

active_experience.current_change: improve creature anatomy presentation and mouth placement while preserving the existing ecosystem and finer fluid layer
simulation_changes: morphology-aware head frame computed from actual head/neck body nodes and facing
one persistent snout guide node per creature added by creature_world_overhaul
existing V107 jaw and tongue nodes re-anchored into the local head frame instead of fixed screen-horizontal cheek placement
family-specific jaw geometry for crab, bug, silkborn, mirekin, scavenger, reedscale, hunter, grazer, climber, amphib, burrower, winged, melt and bone families
2x-per-axis refined water field and existing creature-water coupling remain active
presentation_changes: thicker two-segment articulated limb rendering around existing limb anchors and hand nodes
family-dependent torso proportions and shell/skin envelopes around actual body nodes
front/underside mouth silhouettes with mandibles, chelicerae, snouts or beaks depending on family
eyes moved to upper/front skull positions
wet highlights continue to derive from simulated local saturation
additional terrain surface relief derived from actual material boundary samples
approximations: creature_world_overhaul is procedural Canvas2D rendering over the existing point/constraint body simulation; it is not a new biomechanics solver
the new snout node and jaw re-anchoring are authored morphology constraints rather than anatomical muscle simulation
limb mid-joints in the visual overlay are derived bend points because the old core limb representation stores an anchor and hand end-effector rather than a full two-bone limb chain
terrain relief is presentation derived from actual material surfaces, not additional terrain physics
fluid_refinement remains a conservative 2x subcell volume-relaxation approximation and is not CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

legacy_snapshot.note: Pre-restoration V100-V110 snapshot without the current upgrade layers.

active_objective: Obtain independent CI evidence for creature_world_overhaul, then exercise the deployed ecosystem in a functioning browser and visually inspect mouth placement, silhouette readability, frame cost and interaction with the refined water layer.
next_gate: CI_PASS for creature_rig_overhaul requires the Codehood workflow to execute tests/creature_rig_overhaul.test.mjs. LIVE_TESTED still requires actual deployed browser execution; source wiring and CI alone are insufficient.
invariants: The ecosystem sandbox is the primary user-facing experience
Presentation layers must not be described as physics
No authored controller may be called learning
No mutation-only system may be called evolution
Head-local jaw placement must remain tied to actual creature head/neck state
fluid_refinement must not be called CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM
CI_PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
